incident_details.description: Critical incident involving active compromise of KELLYWANG's endpoint with NetWitness alerts indicating system instability, data exfiltration attempts, and unauthorized system modifications. Immediate containment and forensic preservation are required.

risk_rating.rationale: High CPU usage, core dumps, and malicious network activity indicate active system compromise with high risk of crashes, data exfiltration, and integrity breaches.

triage.ioc_summary:
[AVAILABILITY] High CPU usage, Frequent core dump and/or traceback generation — High risk score and NetWitness alert indicate system instability and crashes.
[CONFIDENTIALITY] Changes in network traffic telemetry (known bad IPs/domains), Anomalous file transfers — Malicious activity detected by security tool suggests data exfiltration or unauthorized access.
[INTEGRITY] Unknown process running, Unknown binaries installed, Configuration changes — Compromised system likely altered processes, installed unauthorized software, and modified configurations.
